cases.sentence: Обрадовался я, когда мне сказали, пойдем в ___ Господень.
cases.explain: The preposition в (into) governing direction takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Ноги наши стоят у твоих ___, Иерусалим.
cases.explain: The preposition у (at/by) governs the genitive case.
Город is the predicate nominative after the copula.

cases.sentence: Туда поднимаются роды, роды Господни по ___ Израиля.
cases.explain: The preposition по (according to) governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Там стоят престолы суда, престолы ___ Давидова.
cases.explain: The genitive case shows possession with the possessive adjective.
The preposition для (for) governs the genitive case.

reading.ru: Обрадовался я, когда мне сказали, пойдем в дом Господень.
reading.question: What made the psalmist glad?
options: When he was told 'Let's go to the Lord's house'
reading.correct: When he was told 'Let's go to the Lord's house'
reading.explain: The verse states: Обрадовался я, когда мне сказали, пойдем в дом Господень — I was glad when they said to me, Let's go to the Lord's house.

reading.ru: Ноги наши стоят у твоих ворот, Иерусалим.
reading.question: Where are the feet of those described in the psalm?
reading.explain: The verse describes their arrival: Ноги наши стоят у твоих ворот, Иерусалим — Our feet are standing within your gates, Jerusalem.

reading.question: How is Jerusalem described?
reading.explain: The description is: Иерусалим — плотно застроенный город — Jerusalem is a city that is compactly built.

reading.ru: Туда поднимаются роды, роды Господни по закону Израиля, воздать хвалу имени Господа.
reading.question: Why do the tribes go up to Jerusalem?
options: To give thanks to the Lord's name according to Israel's law
reading.correct: To give thanks to the Lord's name according to Israel's law
reading.explain: The verse explains: роды поднимаются туда, чтобы воздать хвалу имени Господа — the tribes go up there to give thanks to the Lord's name.

reading.ru: Молитесь о мире для Иерусалима, пусть будут благополучны любящие тебя.
reading.question: What is the prayer request for those who love Jerusalem?
options: Pray for peace for Jerusalem, may those who love you prosper
reading.correct: Pray for peace for Jerusalem, may those who love you prosper
reading.explain: The prayer is: Молитесь о мире для Иерусалима, пусть будут благополучны любящие тебя — Pray for the peace of Jerusalem; may those who love you prosper.

reading.ru: Ради братьев и моих друзей скажу — мир тебе, Иерусалим.
reading.question: Why does the psalmist wish peace to Jerusalem?
options: For the sake of his brothers and friends
reading.correct: For the sake of his brothers and friends
reading.explain: The verse states: Ради братьев и моих друзей скажу — мир тебе — For my brothers' and companions' sake, I will say, Peace be within you.
